# BedrockAddonManager

<!-- docs:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

BedrockAddonManager hosts resource packs over HTTP and reads their manifests. Players still need another way to download the packs because the plugin does not send offers.
<!-- docs:end summary -->

<!-- docs:begin reference -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs from package, action, extension, and component docs metadata. Run `pnpm readme`. -->

See the [plugin guide](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/packages/bedrock-addon-manager/docs/) and [API reference](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/api/plugins/bedrock-addon-manager/) on the documentation site.
<!-- docs:end reference -->

## Installation

Download `bedrock-addon-manager.wasm` from the plugin's GitHub release, put it in your server's `plugins/` folder, and restart Pumpkin. On the first load, a full restart lets Pumpkin ask for the plugin's permissions; hot reload cannot prompt for them.

BedrockAddonManager scans and hosts packs. It does not send resource-pack offers to players, so clients are not prompted to download them and `packs.force` has no effect.

## Adding packs

Put `.mcpack` files, or `.mcaddon` bundles, in `plugins/data/BedrockAddonManager/packs/` and run `/baddon reload` (or restart the server). The plugin reads each pack's `manifest.json` for its UUID, version and flags, and serves the pack over HTTP. `pumpkin.toml` is never changed.

- Packs are never picked up on their own. They are read on server start and on `/baddon reload`.
- A `.mcaddon` often holds a behavior pack next to the resource pack. Pumpkin can't use behavior packs, so only the resource pack is taken (written to `packs/.extracted/` and served from there) and the rest is logged as left out. A pack from a bundle is named after the bundle: `Bundle.mcaddon` becomes `Bundle.mcpack`, or `Bundle - <pack>.mcpack` when it holds several. Use that name in `overrides`.
- Reachable URLs: set `web.public_url` to an address players can reach. If it is empty and `web.bind` is `0.0.0.0`, the plugin asks [UPnPumpkin](../upnpumpkin/README.md) to open `web.port` on your router and uses the public address it returns (for example, `http://203.0.113.7:8123`). Nothing is opened when this machine already has a public address. Without UPnPumpkin, the plugin warns and falls back to `127.0.0.1`, which only works for players on the server machine. Set `web.port_forwarding = false` to opt out.

## Permissions

<!-- docs:begin permissions -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Pumpkin asks you to approve these on the server console when it loads the plugin. It skips the question when the `[plugins]` table in `pumpkin.toml` lists all of them in `allowed_permissions` or sets `ask_permission_confirmation = false`. Pumpkin remembers your answer and asks again after the plugin file or this list changes.

| Permission | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `fs.read.data` | Read the packs folder and the plugin config in its data folder. |
| `fs.write.data` | Create and update the config, and write the resource packs found in `.mcaddon` files. |
| `network.tcp.bind` | Listen for pack downloads from Bedrock clients. |
| `http.outbound` | Check Pumpkin Market for plugin updates. |
<!-- docs:end permissions -->

## Commands

<!-- docs:begin commands -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

| Command | Description | Permission | Default access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/baddon list` | List detected packs and their effective settings | `BedrockAddonManager:command.baddon.list` | everyone |
| `/baddon reload` | Reload `config.toml` and rescan the packs folder | `BedrockAddonManager:command.baddon.reload` | operators (level 3) |
<!-- docs:end commands -->

## Configuration

<!-- docs:begin config -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Settings live in `plugins/data/BedrockAddonManager/config.toml`. The plugin creates the file if needed, adds settings from the schema and removes settings no longer defined there. Values for existing settings are preserved.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `web.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Serve the packs over HTTP. Turn this off if the packs are hosted elsewhere and every pack has a download_url override. |
| `web.bind` | string | `"0.0.0.0"` | IPv4 address to listen on. |
| `web.port` | integer | `8123` | Port to listen on. |
| `web.public_url` | string | `""` | Base URL Bedrock clients should use to download packs, without a trailing slash, query or fragment; for example "https://packs.example.com". The plugin serves plain HTTP. Put a reverse proxy in front of it for HTTPS. When empty, the plugin uses the public address reported by UPnPumpkin if forwarding succeeds, or a loopback URL on the configured port otherwise. A loopback URL works only for players on the server machine. |
| `web.port_forwarding` | boolean | `true` | When `public_url` is empty and `bind` is "0.0.0.0", ask UPnPumpkin to open `port` on your router (UPnP or NAT-PMP) and use the public address it returns. No port is opened when this machine already has a public address or UPnPumpkin is not installed. Set to false to disable forwarding. |
| `packs.directory` | string | `"packs"` | Folder inside this plugin's data folder that is scanned for .mcpack and .mcaddon files. |
| `packs.force` | boolean | `false` | Require pack downloads before players can join. This setting has no effect because BedrockAddonManager does not send pack offers to players. |
| `overrides."<file>".enabled` | boolean | none | Set to false to leave the pack out entirely. |
| `overrides."<file>".order` | integer | none | Position in the pack list, lowest first. |
| `overrides."<file>".download_url` | string | none | Download the pack from this URL instead of the built-in web server, for example a CDN. |
| `overrides."<file>".addon_pack` | boolean | none | Mark the pack as an add-on pack. Normally derived from the manifest. |
| `overrides."<file>".has_scripts` | boolean | none | Mark the pack as containing scripts. Normally derived from the manifest. |
| `overrides."<file>".rtx_enabled` | boolean | none | Enable ray tracing for the pack. Normally derived from the manifest. |
| `overrides."<file>".sub_pack_name` | string | none | Name of the sub-pack to activate. |
| `overrides."<file>".content_key` | string | none | Decryption key for an encrypted pack. |
| `overrides."<file>".content_id` | string | none | Content identifier of the pack. |

<details>
<summary>A fresh install gets this file:</summary>

```toml
# BedrockAddonManager configuration.
# This file is managed by the plugin: when it starts, settings that were added are written here with
# their defaults and settings that were removed are dropped. Your values are kept; comments you add
# are not. Changes apply after `/baddon reload` or a server restart.

# The web server that serves the packs to Bedrock clients.
[web]

# Serve the packs over HTTP. Turn this off if the packs are hosted elsewhere and every pack has a
# download_url override.
enabled = true

# IPv4 address to listen on.
bind = "0.0.0.0"

# Port to listen on.
port = 8123

# Base URL Bedrock clients should use to download packs, without a trailing slash, query or
# fragment; for example "https://packs.example.com". The plugin serves plain HTTP. Put a reverse
# proxy in front of it for HTTPS. When empty, the plugin uses the public address reported by
# UPnPumpkin if forwarding succeeds, or a loopback URL on the configured port otherwise. A loopback
# URL works only for players on the server machine.
public_url = ""

# When `public_url` is empty and `bind` is "0.0.0.0", ask UPnPumpkin to open `port` on your router
# (UPnP or NAT-PMP) and use the public address it returns. No port is opened when this machine
# already has a public address or UPnPumpkin is not installed. Set to false to disable forwarding.
port_forwarding = true

# Where the packs are and how they are listed.
[packs]

# Folder inside this plugin's data folder that is scanned for .mcpack and .mcaddon files.
directory = "packs"

# Require pack downloads before players can join. This setting has no effect because
# BedrockAddonManager does not send pack offers to players.
force = false

# Per-pack overrides, keyed by file name. For packs extracted from a `.mcaddon`, use the name shown
# by `/baddon list`. All settings are optional. Packs are ordered by `order` (lowest first, default
# 0), then by file name.
#
# [overrides."My Pack.mcpack"]
# enabled = false  # Set to false to leave the pack out entirely.
# order = 10  # Position in the pack list, lowest first.
# download_url = "https://cdn.example.com/my-pack.mcpack"  # Download the pack from this URL instead of the built-in web server, for example a CDN.
# addon_pack = true  # Mark the pack as an add-on pack. Normally derived from the manifest.
# has_scripts = false  # Mark the pack as containing scripts. Normally derived from the manifest.
# rtx_enabled = false  # Enable ray tracing for the pack. Normally derived from the manifest.
# sub_pack_name = "high_res"  # Name of the sub-pack to activate.
# content_key = "..."  # Decryption key for an encrypted pack.
# content_id = "..."  # Content identifier of the pack.
```
</details>
<!-- docs:end config -->
